widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Lin Xi, the teenage girl from <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>, slender figure, neat short hair, neutral stubborn facial features, casual daily home outfit; her fearless upright posture and defiant expression are referenced from the three character reference pictures.
<Subject 2> is Father, middle-aged male figure matching the family scene character logic, tall build, stern facial lines, dark home casual shirt, irritable and rigid facial expression reference matching the indoor scene tone.
<Subject 3> is Mother, middle-aged female figure matching the family scene character logic, soft facial features, loose domestic blouse, flustered helpless facial expression matching the indoor scene atmosphere.
<Subject 4> is the family living room indoor environment from <Picture 4>, small apartment entrance living room, wooden interior door, wooden stair passage outside the door, warm dim indoor home lighting, sofa and daily sundries placed in the background, complete fixed scene layout fully referenced from the scene reference picture.
<Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3> are character reference keyframes defining the appearance, facial features and core demeanor of <Subject 1> Lin Xi.
<Picture 4> is the fixed scene reference keyframe for all shots, the whole video’s background environment is built based on this picture.
summary:
[reference generation] The target video takes <Subject 4> home living room as the fixed scene, uses <Picture 1><Picture 2><Picture 3> to fix Lin Xi's appearance and stubborn temperament. The plot presents a fierce family conflict: Lin Xi stands fearlessly close to Father, Mother stands aside flustered and pleads, Father grits teeth and compromises, glares at Lin Xi fiercely then slams the door and walks down the stairs first; slight camera shake is used to strengthen tense conflict atmosphere, three characters deliver complete dialogue with timbre matching domestic middle-aged and teenage voice characteristics.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - all facial features, body shape, daily outfit and stubborn fearless expression characteristics from <Picture 1><Picture 2><Picture 3> are completely retained, posture keeps upright and unyielding throughout the video.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - middle-aged stern appearance, irritable facial muscle state and tall body proportion are retained, angry glaring and gritted-teeth movements keep consistent character logic.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - soft facial features, flustered helpless facial state and shrinking uneasy standing posture are fully retained.
<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the whole living room entrance layout, wooden door, stair passage, indoor furnishings and dim warm home lighting from <Picture 4> are completely preserved as unified background for all shots.
detailed_description:
The target video adopts realistic domestic drama live-action style, dim warm indoor ambient light, slight handheld camera jitter throughout to render intense conflicting atmosphere, all scene backgrounds strictly follow the layout of <Picture 4>.
[Shot 1] Medium shot framing the entrance area of <Subject 4> home living room, camera shakes slightly with small amplitude constantly. <Subject 1> Lin Xi stands in the center foreground, head held high, chest out, stepping forward to lean close to <Subject 2> Father, her facial expression is fearless and unyielding, fully consistent with the stubborn demeanor defined by <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, <Picture 3>. <Subject 3> Mother stands one step behind Father on the right side of the frame, body slightly hunched, hands twisted in front of abdomen, eyes flustered and wandering, showing obvious helplessness. <Subject 1> (S1), teenage girl with clear sharp young voice, stares straight at Father and speaks firmly without trembling, <d>[Chinese]你打啊，打了我你们就都别去！</d> Her body does not retreat at all after finishing the line, still keeping the upright forward leaning posture.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.200, the shot stays medium shot with sustained subtle camera shake, frame composition unchanged. <Subject 3> Mother takes half a small step forward, eyebrows wrinkled tightly, eyes filled with anxiety, voice soft and trembling (S2), she pleads anxiously towards Lin Xi, <d>[Chinese]夕夕，你懂事点……</d> She reaches out one hand slightly trying to pull Lin Xi’s arm but hesitates and retracts halfway, whole body posture remains flustered and at a loss.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.100, the shot remains medium shot, camera shake amplitude slightly increases to highlight outburst of anger. <Subject 2> Father’s jaw tightens, teeth gritted hard, facial muscles tense with rage, he throws a fierce sharp glare straight at <Subject 1> Lin Xi, his voice deep and gruff with suppressed anger (S3), shouts resentfully, <d>[Chinese]吃吃吃！带她去！要是你敢弄砸了，我饶不了你！</d> Right after finishing the line, Father sharply twists his body to turn around, strides quickly toward the wooden entrance door of <Subject 4> scene, grabs the door handle and slams the wooden door hard with a loud bang, then rushes out the door and walks down the external stair passage quickly, leaving Lin Xi and Mother standing inside the living room staring at the closed door.
overall_soundscape:
Continuous subtle handheld camera mechanical jitter noise runs through the whole video; fabric friction sounds from three characters’ slight body movements; clear heavy wooden door slamming impact sound at the end of Shot 3; faint distant stair stepping footsteps after the door shuts. Low quiet indoor home room tone exists as bottom layer all the time.
non_diegetic_music:
N/A

nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.
